scenes.text: This morning Anthropic patched four Claude Code regressions. Their evals never caught a single one. Here's how I catch mine.

scenes.text: Seven weeks of silent regressions, eight bugs filed in a day, fifty times quota burn from the wrapper bug in March — and the only reason mine didn't break was three lines of config.

scenes.text: Pin the CLI — uninstall global, reinstall the last verified release, lock the version line in npmrc so future updates can't touch you.
scenes.spokenText: Pin the C L I — uninstall global, reinstall the last verified release, lock the version line in N P M R C so future updates can't touch you.

scenes.text: Then settings.json — set the effort level and a model allowlist, because that's where Anthropic's silent defaults sneak in. And a Python stop hook that replays five golden prompts every session, with expected outputs committed to the repo. It's your CI, for a CLI that doesn't ship one.
